36992.commentary: (SNa) niccammā'ti khurato paṭṭhāya yāva siṅgamūlā sakalasarīrato uddālitacammā kiṃsukarāsivaṇṇā.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, phass'āhāro daṭṭhabbo? seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāvī niccammā kuḍḍañ'ce nissāya tiṭṭheyya

36994.meaning1: similar to a flayed cow; like a skinless cow
